# Variant

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 12 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Signed-out design-tool chrome: a near-black page, off-white Variant Neue Display headline, 6px chips, a 10px composer with a 0.5px white ring, and white-at-10% auth buttons. One dark paint. No light theme on the public pages..

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Homepage, /authentication and /terms-and-privacy measured. Email field typed only to read the enabled button, then cleared. Not submitted. Google sign-in not clicked. No payment.. Themes: dark.

A token set for Variant's signed-out web surfaces. Read live from [variant.com](https://variant.com/) on 2026-11-19 and photographed on 2026-11-22. The host is Variant Design, Inc. The title is "Variant – Endless designs for your ideas, just scroll."

The signed-out product is one dark screen, not a marketing site. `/` is a 408px column (headline, two chips, a composer) beside a scrolling grid of design widgets. "Sign up / Sign in" opens `/authentication`, one wall for login and signup. Terms and privacy share `/terms-and-privacy`. There is no light theme: forcing `prefers-color-scheme: light` left the page on `rgb(34, 34, 34)`.

Measured in the T3 preview browser at CSS 1440×900 and 390×844, both at devicePixelRatio 2. Page shots are in `screenshots/`. Every colour, length and font string was read with `getComputedStyle` or from an authored custom property. Nothing was submitted on the 2026-11-22 pass. Google sign-in was not clicked. `login-extracted` stays not-started. `catalog.json` was left alone. This file was updated by hand. `make design-md` was not run.

### Fonts (from README.md)

- Variant Neue Display. Homepage h1. Weights 100 through 900, plus italics, served from `/fonts/neue-haas-grotesk/variant-neue-display/`. Not shipped.
- Variant Neue Text. Homepage body, chips and composer. Weights 400, 500 and 700, plus italics. Not shipped.
- Inter, with an Inter Fallback. Auth page, legal page, and the body stack under the Neue families. Variable woff2, 100 to 900. A public family. The files are not copied here.
- Advercase. Declared as `--font-advercase` and as a font-face at weight 400. Not used on the surfaces that were measured.
- The mono stack is the declared `--font-mono` (ui-monospace, Menlo, Monaco, and the rest). No code sample was on the signed-out pages.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- Screenshots from 2026-11-22 are 256-colour PNGs. Flat fills survive. The widget photographs band. Read colours from tokens.json, not from a pixel.
- The legal shot is a crop of the tabs and the heading. The rest of the article prints a contact email, a street address, and a phone line, so it was not committed.
- The phone auth card is 400px wide inside a 390 frame. The overflow in screenshots/auth-dark-390.png is what the page painted.
- The user-agent focus outline `rgb(229, 151, 0)` is the browser default (`accent-color: auto`). It is recorded because it was painted. It is not a Variant token.
- Blues, coral, billing past-due colours, and the gray HSL ramps are declared in CSS. They were not painted on the signed-out pages. `core.palette` keeps the declarations and says so.
- `--border-radius` resolves to 12px. The controls on screen were 6px, 8px and 10px. Use the measured radii.
- Sidebar, chat, billing modal, style modal and toast motion live in the same CSS bundle. Those screens were not opened.
- Variant Neue Display, Variant Neue Text and Advercase are proprietary files on variant.com. This package names them and does not ship the files.
- The homepage grid cards are iframes of design widgets. Their inner UI was not measured.
- Pressed states were not taken. A click on "Continue with Email" or the composer Submit would start a flow.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Paint the page near-black and the ink off-white.** The body is `rgb(34, 34, 34)`. The column is `rgb(7, 7, 6)`. The headline is `rgb(240, 237, 229)`, which is the declared `--homepage-offwhite`.
2. **Set display type in Variant Neue Display at 32/36, weight 400.** The homepage headline is that, with `0.32px` tracking. Auth and legal titles switch to Inter 21/32 weight 500.
3. **Use a 6px radius on chips and auth controls, 8px on grid cards, 10px on the composer.** The declared `--border-radius` is 12px and was not the radius of these controls.
4. **Fill actions with white at 10% opacity, not a blue.** "Continue with Google" and the enabled email button are `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`. Hover on the enabled button moves to `0.15`. The empty email button keeps the same fill and drops the label to `0.5`.
5. **Hairline borders are 0.5px at white 10%.** Chips, the email field, and the composer ring all use that. Do not add a drop shadow. None was painted.
6. **Do not invent a light theme or a signed-in shell from this package.** Light preference did not change the paint. Sidebar and billing CSS was not on screen. The shots are in screenshots/.
